reason: CodeRabbit review of issue #114 exposed incomplete access control gate testing. The fixture was testing only `.includes()` but missing 10 other patterns (`some`, `every`, `find`, `findIndex`, `indexOf`, `filter`, `at`, bare indexing, `Set.has()`, hardcoded comparisons). Comprehensive fixture coverage is now mandatory to prevent gaps in authorization enforcement.
evidence: CodeRabbit review threads from PR #114: "all 11 spellings now fail the build, pinned by a fixture that lints a component containing every one" — the fixture was made comprehensive to catch `.includes()`, `.some()`, `.every()`, `.find()`, `.findIndex()`, `.indexOf()`, `.filter()`, `.at()`, bare `[0]` indexing, `new Set(...).has()`, and hardcoded string comparisons.
